developments: Bitcoin climbed overnight to about $61,680 on Kraken at 06:30 UK, roughly $800 above the evening edition, with most of the gain in a jump around 02:00 UK; the overnight high was $61,925.
Zcash rose about 5% to near $758 on Kraken, as KuCoin said it will delist Monero on 30 November and Grayscale said its Zcash commitment will last 'many years', Cointelegraph reported.
Binance said withdrawals are fully restored four weeks after the $6.3 billion October hack, CoinDesk reported.
briefing.changed: A little firmer than the evening. Bitcoin pushed back above $61,000 in thin Asian holiday trade, and ZEC recovered most of Thursday's drop. No new macro news overnight; the big test is this morning's options expiry and a half-day US session.
briefing.question: Does the overnight bounce survive the 08:00 UK options expiry and the first US ETF flow figures after Thanksgiving?

lead.headline: Bitcoin climbs back above $61,000 before monthly options expiry
lead.standfirst: Bitcoin rose about $800 overnight in thin holiday trade, while Zcash gained 5% as a rival privacy coin lost another exchange listing.
body: Bitcoin traded near $61,680 on Kraken at 06:30 UK on Friday, up about $800 from the previous evening, after a jump at around 02:00 UK took it to an overnight high of $61,925, according to Kraken data.

The move came with US markets shut for Thanksgiving and Asian volumes light, and FXStreet described it as a tentative rebound. About $7 billion of bitcoin options expire on Deribit at 08:00 UK, which traders have watched for a pull towards $60,000, where puts cluster.

Zcash rose about 5% to near $758, recovering most of Thursday's fall. KuCoin said it will delist Monero on 30 November and close withdrawals on 31 December, Cointelegraph reported, citing the EU's ban on anonymity-enhancing coins at regulated firms from July 2027. Grayscale's head of research, Zach Pandl, said the firm's commitment to Zcash would continue 'for many years to come'.

Separately, Binance said its withdrawal suspension from the 29 October hack had been fully lifted, CoinDesk reported. The exchange said in early November it had restored 98% of the $6.34 billion affected.

In the UK, Coinbase's European policy head Katie Harries said the FCA was 'getting its approach to DeFi wrong', Cointelegraph reported. FCA final guidance is expected in January. US stock markets reopen for a half-day session closing at 18:00 UK.

headline: Bitcoin rose about $800 overnight to near $61,700 in thin holiday trade, ahead of this morning's $7 billion options expiry. Zcash gained 5% as KuCoin moved to drop Monero and Grayscale backed Zcash.
spoken: Cryptonaire Post, morning edition. A firmer night. Bitcoin is about sixty one thousand, seven hundred dollars, up around eight hundred since last night, in thin holiday trade. Zcash is up about five percent to around seven hundred and sixty dollars, as KuCoin moves to delist rival privacy coin Monero and Grayscale says it is sticking with Zcash. Binance says withdrawals are fully back four weeks after its record hack. Seven billion dollars of bitcoin options expire at eight this morning, and US stocks close early at six this evening. The next red event is the Fed decision on the ninth of December at seven in the evening. Information only, not advice.

stories.title: Bitcoin back above $61,000 overnight
stories.why: Kraken showed BTC near $61,680 at 06:30 UK, about $800 above the evening edition, with an overnight high of $61,925 after a jump around 02:00 UK. That puts it further above Galaxy's $58,525 trigger level, though no single catalyst was reported.
stories.caveat: Holiday volumes are thin, so the move may not reflect broad buying.

note.read: A steady relief bounce after the capitulation signals flagged on Thursday, with shorts likely being squeezed in thin trade.
note.alt: Moves into an options expiry often reverse once the contracts settle, so the bounce may fade after 08:00 UK.
note.change: Holding above $61,000 through the expiry and the US half-day would strengthen the bounce; a drop back below $60,000 would undo it.

stories.title: ZEC up 5% as KuCoin drops Monero and Grayscale backs Zcash
stories.why: Kraken showed ZEC near $758 at 06:30 UK, up from about $721 last night. KuCoin will delist Monero on 30 November, citing the EU ban on anonymity-enhancing coins at regulated firms from 10 July 2027; Monero fell 10.5% to about $450. Grayscale's Zach Pandl said its Zcash commitment will last 'many years'; its Zcash ETF assets were $406 million on Wednesday, down from $1 billion in September, Cointelegraph reported.
stories.caveat: The EU rule could in time hit ZEC listings at EU venues too; KuCoin has not said anything about ZEC.

note.read: Traders may be treating Zcash's optional privacy and US ETF as protection from the delisting wave that is hitting Monero.
note.alt: The rise may simply be a rebound from Thursday's leverage flush, unrelated to Monero.
note.change: Any major exchange naming ZEC in a delisting, or further falls in the Grayscale ETF's assets, would change this read.

stories.title: Monthly options expiry lands at 08:00 UK
stories.why: About $7 billion of bitcoin options expire on Deribit at 08:00 UK, the evening edition reported, with puts clustered near $60,000. Bitcoin sits about $1,700 above that level going in, so the expiry could pull the price around in the hours either side.

stories.title: Binance says withdrawals fully restored after record hack
stories.why: Binance said the withdrawal suspension from the 29 October hack, which affected about $6.3 billion, has been fully lifted; TRM Labs tied the attack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group, CoinDesk reported. It removes one overhang for the biggest exchange, though the hack still shapes regulators' views.

stories.title: Coinbase says the UK is 'getting it wrong' on DeFi
stories.why: Coinbase's European policy head Katie Harries said the FCA's plans are 'a ban on giving [UK consumers] a regulated route' to DeFi, Cointelegraph reported. The FCA's consultation closed on 18 November, final guidance is expected in January 2027 and the regime starts on 25 October 2027. No FCA response was in its feed overnight.

stories.title: Democrat senators urge SEC to withdraw crypto rules
stories.why: Senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Van Hollen asked SEC Chair Paul Atkins to withdraw Regulation Crypto Assets and the innovation exemption for tokenised securities, The Block reported. A reminder that the SEC's friendlier rules face political push-back, though the senators cannot block them alone.

stories.title: Zebra 7.2.0-beta.2 released
stories.why: The Zcash Foundation published a second beta of its Zebra node, version 7.2.0, on GitHub overnight. A routine pre-release, not a network upgrade; node operators would normally wait for the full release.

explained.title: Why Monero is being delisted but Zcash mostly is not
body: Monero hides every transaction by default, so an exchange cannot see where coins came from. Zcash lets users choose: transparent addresses work much like bitcoin, and only shielded ones are private.

Exchanges under anti-money-laundering rules, such as the EU's ban from July 2027, find default privacy hardest to accept. Optional privacy has so far kept Zcash on more venues, though the EU rule covers anonymity-enhancing coins broadly.

investigating: Will the EU ban from July 2027 catch ZEC at EU exchanges as well as Monero? Evidence: exchange notices naming ZEC, or EU guidance on what counts as an anonymity-enhancing coin.
Does the bounce hold after expiry? Evidence: bitcoin's price around 08:00 UK and the first US ETF flow figures after Thanksgiving, due this evening.
Will the FCA respond to Coinbase's criticism of its DeFi plans? Evidence: an FCA statement; none in its feed overnight.
